talipp - incremental technical analysis library for python
High-performance technical analysis indicators and backtesting framework in TypeScript. Zero dependencies. ✨ See how! 👀
A python library for computing technical analysis indicators on streaming data.
Modular, chainable sliding windows with various signal processing functions such as normalization, RSI, ROC and other technical indicators.

Streaming-first technical indicators with a Rust core: native Python, Node.js and WebAssembly bindings plus a C ABI hub for C, C++, C#, Go, Java and R. 514 indicators, O(1) per-tick updates, no system dependencies. Drop-in TA-Lib replacement.

Trading charts for the web, drawn with Canvas 2D or WebGL: 134 indicators, 69 drawing tools, 18 chart types, live exchange feeds, orders on the chart, replay and backtesting, touch-ready on phones. Zero dependencies. TypeScript, React, Vue, Svelte.

Free, open-source charts for crypto, stocks and forex that your AI agent can drive. Indicators, drawing tools, scripts with strategy backtests, alerts, bar replay and multi-chart layouts, with an MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI.

Dumb-as-rocks OHLC analyzer. POST your bars + the indicators you want, get back exactly what you asked for. RSI/MACD/Bollinger/ADX/ATR/VWAP/Ichimoku, plus SMC primitives: Order Blocks, FVGs, BOS/CHoCH, swing structure. Stateless HTTP + MCP, no database, no AI-powered signals, no $97/mo Discord upsell.
Every smart contract deserves intelligence, not just data. MCP server for on-chain calculated indicators (EMA, RSI, VWAP, Bollinger, volatility) via Chainlink.
Dependency-free TypeScript technical indicators with hand-verifiable tests, open datasets and reproducible evidence — companion to tradingcompendium.com
